fusions.name: Fingerling Flick
fusions.desc: Flicks a scale that deals 4 damage, then leaps to 1 more enemy within 3.5 tiles for 60% of the damage.

fusions.name: Snatch and Dart
fusions.desc: A grabbing lunge that rushes you up to 6 tiles to the target, deals 14 damage and hits up to 1.6 times harder at maximum range.

fusions.name: Sleight of Scale
fusions.desc: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting. Your movement speed rises 25% for 4s after you use it.

fusions.name: Pocketed Scraps
fusions.desc: Each time you kill an enemy, you recover 8 stamina. You gain 5% dodge chance.
